concepts.gloss_en: The aspect/category of the Tabernacle (Mishkan) as a concept

members.note: representative; the bare construct noun phrase naming the concept

concepts.gloss_en: The act/state of becoming an aspect of the Tabernacle — a predication, not the concept 'aspect of Tabernacle' itself

members.note: adds the verb נעשה ('becomes'); per rule 4 an action/state about X is not X. Predicative phrase, not identical to the noun בחינת משכן

notes: Both cited from lm2:4 but the proof quotes do not actually display either target string, so referent verification is limited. Kept separate: 'נעשה בחינת משכן' is a verbal predication (becomes an aspect of the Mishkan), while 'בחינת משכן' is the bare concept-noun. Under-merge preferred.
